info.name: StampMitra Developer API
info.description: Postman collection for the StampMitra Developer API (verification, e-Stamp, usage and logs, webhook events). Generated from the same OpenAPI document as https://developer.stampmitra.in/openapi.json. Set {{baseUrl}} and {{apiKey}} (your sk_test_... key) in the collection Variables.

request.description: Validates and verifies a PAN. Requires the `verification.pan.read` scope on the API key. Metered as `pan.verify` after a successful response - usage is only recorded (and the fulfilment wallet debited, for priced services) once verification completes successfully. The response below is the exact real shape returned by `/v1/verify/pan`, including its `referenceId` field.

response.name: 200 Success
response.body:
{
  "referenceId": "SMV-20260927-8F42K7",
  "pan": "ABCDE1234F",
  "type": "Individual",
  "valid": true,
  "registeredName": "RAHUL KUMAR",
  "fatherName": "SURESH KUMAR",
  "panStatus": "VALID",
  "panStatusCode": "E",
  "panStatusDescription": "Existing and valid PAN",
  "nameMatchResult": "MATCH",
  "nameMatchScore": "100",
  "aadhaarSeedingStatus": "y",
  "aadhaarSeedingStatusDescription": "Aadhaar linked",
  "lastUpdatedAt": "2023-04-01",
  "message": "PAN is Valid"
}

response.name: 400 Validation error
401 Missing or invalid API key
402 Insufficient wallet balance
403 Valid key, missing required scope
429 Rate limited
502 Upstream verification service unreachable

item.name: List entitled services (generic catalog, covers e-Stamp services too)

request.description: Returns every service (verification AND e-Stamp) this organization is entitled to. There is no e-Stamp-specific catalog endpoint yet; e-Stamp instruments surface here as regular service entries once entitled.

response.name: 200 Success

request.description: Detail for a single serviceCode, if entitled and active.

item.name: Get the e-Stamp input field schema

request.description: Generic form-rendering metadata for the e-Stamp product. `serviceCode` is accepted for forward-compatible route shape parity with other schema lookups; e-Stamp has exactly one schema regardless of its value. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
Served from StampMitra's synced master-data catalogue. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
There is no separate instrument entity distinct from an article - this returns the same state-scoped article catalogue as the articles endpoint below. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.
`instrumentCode` is treated as a state code here - there is no article sub-breakdown below the state-scoped list. Requires the `estamp.read` scope.

item.name: Calculate authoritative e-Stamp duty + service charges

request.description: Runs the one authoritative pricing calculation; the response amount is never recalculated or overridden client-side. Requires the `estamp.duty.calculate` scope. Metered against your fulfilment wallet.
Attaches or corrects the customer/party details on an existing e-Stamp order. Requires the `estamp.parties.write` scope. Metered against your fulfilment wallet.

item.name: Create an order (generic - works for any entitled serviceCode, including e-Stamp)

request.description: Generic order-creation endpoint. For e-Stamp, pass an e-Stamp `serviceCode` (from GET /v1/services) and put instrument/party/value details in the free-form `details` object. There is no e-Stamp-specific request/response contract yet (no first-class `state`, `article`, `parties[]` fields) - the shape of `details` for e-Stamp is not finalized upstream.
Fetch an order by its B2B-assigned id.
Poll the current lifecycle status of an order.
Create a payment intent (Razorpay-backed) for an order.
Fetch the current state of a payment intent.
Fetch the payment associated with a given order.
List generated documents (e.g. the e-Stamp certificate PDF) for a completed order.
Get a (typically short-lived, signed) URL to download a specific document.
Current billing period totals, calls by service, calls by day and a 6-month calls-by-period trend for the organization that owns the API key.
